title: adapter-cloudflare does not bundle service-worker.js since around next.207 - results in 404 and thus failed SW registration

labels.name: p2-nice-to-have
labels.description: SvelteKit cannot be used by a small number of people, quality of life improvements, etc.

body:
### Describe the bug

Since around next.207 `adapter-cloudflare` seems not to bundle `service-worker.js`

When testing locally, everything seems OK. The SW file is present in the `./svelte-kit/cloudflare` builld folder - as it was with older versions of Sveltekit. When running `npm run preview` the SW is being successfully registered according to Chrome Dev Tools.

After deployment﻿ to CF, and running the site, the following error shows in the console log:
`Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Failed to register a ServiceWorker for scope ('https://sw-cloudflare-repro.pages.dev/') with script ('https://sw-cloudflare-repro.pages.dev/service-worker.js'): A bad HTTP response code (404) was received when fetching the script.`

Also, according to Dev Tools, the SW is not present.


### Reproduction

[https://github.com/codepainting/sw-cloudflare-repro](https://github.com/codepainting/sw-cloudflare-repro)

Basically it's the standard demo app, with the following additions:
+ `service-worker.js` is included in `/src`
+ `import adapter from '@sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare';` is configured

Demo site:
[https://sw-cloudflare-repro.pages.dev/](https://sw-cloudflare-repro.pages.dev/)

Run demo site.
Look into the console logs.

### Logs

```shell
Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Failed to register a ServiceWorker for scope ('https://sw-cloudflare-repro.pages.dev/') with script ('https://sw-cloudflare-repro.pages.dev/service-worker.js'): A bad HTTP response code (404) was received when fetching the script.
```


### System Info

```shell
System:
    OS: Linux 4.19 Ubuntu 20.04.3 LTS (Focal Fossa)
    CPU: (4) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7600K CPU @ 3.80GHz
    Memory: 19.42 GB / 25.03 GB
    Container: Yes
    Shell: 5.8 - /usr/bin/zsh
  Binaries:
    Node: 16.13.0 - ~/.volta/tools/image/node/16.13.0/bin/node
    Yarn: 1.22.4 - ~/.volta/bin/yarn
    npm: 8.1.4 - ~/.volta/tools/image/npm/8.1.4/bin/npm
  npmPackages:
    @sveltejs/adapter-auto: next => 1.0.0-next.7 
    @sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare: ^1.0.0-next.5 => 1.0.0-next.5 
    @sveltejs/kit: next => 1.0.0-next.213 
    svelte: ^3.44.0 => 3.44.3
```


### Severity

blocking an upgrade
